Description
1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar Lady of Liberty is manufactured by the bullion brand –
PAMP Suisse
which is recognized around the globe for its innovative designs, state-of-the-art facilities, and industry-leading efforts to curtail
precious metal counterfeiting
.
PAMP Suisse, a prominent Swiss refinery was founded in Ticino in 1977. It quickly rose to prominence due to its outstanding craftsmanship. Investors and Collectors around the glove love the PAMP bullion brand. It Produces high-quality bullion bars and uses the most recent technologies to prevent bullion counterfeiting, Lady Fortuna is one of the most well-known series of the mint.
The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver bar contains 1 troy oz of silver of purity .999  and  the weight and purity of these silver bars are backed by PAMP Suisse.
These bars are manufactured in the
USA
Design of the 1 oz Silver Bar – PAMP Suisse Lady of Liberty .999
The
1 oz PAMP Lady of Liberty Silver Bar .999 Fine
is a remarkable tribute to freedom, democracy, and enlightenment, embodying the ideals that define the American spirit. Produced by MKS PAMP GROUP, one of the world’s leading refiners of precious metals, this .999 fine silver bar is meticulously crafted in state-of-the-art minting facilities in the USA, adhering to the renowned Swiss standards of quality.
This silver bar
showcases a modernized interpretation of the Lady of Liberty, blending classical elegance with contemporary design. She is depicted wearing a flowing Greco-Roman toga, symbolizing democratic values, while holding a sword, representing her unwavering defense of freedom. In her other hand, she carries a lantern, illuminating the path toward a brighter future. The stunning Art Deco-style background further enhances the sophisticated and powerful imagery, making this bar a must-have for collectors and investors alike
Main Highlights of the 1 oz Silver Bar – PAMP Suisse Lady of Liberty .999
Contains 1 troy oz of .999 fine silver.
Produced by the leading Swiss precious refiner, PAMP Suisse but in the USA.
Each of the silver bars comes with its original own assay card.
Obverse: Features the PAMP logo, inscriptions read: “1 OUNCES FINE SILVER 999”. Includes advanced anti-counterfeit micro-engraving and a special USA mint mark, ensuring authenticity and security.
Reverse
:
Features an Art Deco-inspired Lady of Liberty design, symbolizing democracy and freedom
